about: Delivery targets for product demos, store preview videos, App Store creative-asset videos and loops. Every row with official: true was read from its source_url on verified_on (a row's own verified_on wins over the file's); a null is a number nobody read from the official page, never fill it from memory. Rows with official: false are this project's defaults, not a platform rule. aim_seconds, min_scene_seconds and max_scene_speed are this project's choices on every row. Read by democut.py specs, time, build and validate.
unverified: appstore-iphone-69, appstore-iphone-55, appstore-ipad-13, appstore-mac: max_bytes is stated as 500 MB for the upload; no per-device figure exists
appstore-iphone-69, appstore-iphone-55, appstore-ipad-13, appstore-mac: whether App Store Connect accepts a file of exactly 30.000 s; democut aims at 15-29.5 s
play-promo: no maximum length is stated on the page, only the 30 s autoplay window
social video limits (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok): not in this file; short-video owns social formats
ph-video: Product Hunt states no video length rule, only that a video is a full YouTube URL

appstore-header-video, appstore-search-video: the creative assets specification states no codec, profile, bitrate, byte cap or audio format (codec, channels, sample rate); those fields are null. democut writes H.264 High 4:2:0 at CRF 18 and, when a variant has audio, AAC 192 kbps stereo at 48 kHz: this project's choices, the same as its web master
appstore-header-video, appstore-search-video: whether a file without an audio track is accepted is not stated; democut renders these silent by default
appstore-header-video, appstore-search-video: whether 29.97 or 59.94 fps counts as 30 or 60 fps is not stated; democut writes exactly 30 or 60, and time and validate want that
appstore-header-video, appstore-search-video: whether App Store Connect accepts a file of exactly 5.000 or 30.000 s is not stated; democut aims at 8-15 s
appstore-header-video.max_count, appstore-search-video.max_count: Apple states no count; a placement shows one asset per product page and language

appstore-search-video.size_range: Apple names 3:2 and a size range; whether a file a pixel off 3:2 passes is not stated, so time and validate want the exact ratio (and even sides, which H.264 4:2:0 needs)

appstore-header-video, appstore-search-video: Apple draws the art safe area only in its downloadable templates, for the stills; whether a video is cropped the same way is not stated. launch-graphics records those boxes on its appstore-header and appstore-search rows; this file does not copy them

appstore-iphone-69.label: App Store app preview, iPhone 6.9 / 6.5 / 6.3 / 6.1 inch
appstore-iphone-69.notes: 886x1920 is the iPhone's own aspect (1290x2796 = 0.4614), so a full-screen phone recording scales in without a stretch. Up to 3 previews per device. App Review 2.3.4: only screen captures of the app itself; narration and overlays are allowed.

appstore-iphone-55.label: App Store app preview, iPhone 5.5 / 4 inch
appstore-iphone-55.notes: The 4.7 inch row is 750x1334. Only these older device sizes take a 1080x1920 preview; the 6.x sizes do not.

appstore-ipad-13.label: App Store app preview, iPad 13 / 11 / 10.5 inch
appstore-ipad-13.notes: The 9.7 inch row is 900x1200. iPad previews may be portrait or landscape.

appstore-mac.label: App Store app preview, Mac and Apple TV
appstore-mac.notes: Landscape only. Apple Vision Pro takes 3840x2160, landscape only.

appstore-header-video.label: App Store product page header video (creative asset, iOS 27 and iPadOS 27)
appstore-header-video.notes: 21:9 at exactly 3840x1646, 30 or 60 fps, 5 to 30 s, .mov, .m4v or .mp4. Loops continuously; muted by default, and the viewer may unmute it on the product page. Optional, separate from previews and screenshots, uploaded per language, shown on iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 or later. Unlike a preview, a creative asset is not held to showing the app in use, but this skill still cuts only the user's real recording. The poster frame is chosen in App Store Connect, applies wherever the asset is used and cannot be edited after approval. Apple's guidance: a poster frame that stands on its own, lead with the value, no quick cuts or fast-moving visuals, a seamless loop, works silent, sound only as brand texture that loops cleanly. Content: no prices, discounts, URLs, copyright symbols, unverified awards, Apple recognitions or other platforms; 4+. Apple lists no universal (16:9) video. aim_seconds, min_scene_seconds and max_scene_speed are this project's reading of that guidance, not Apple numbers.

appstore-search-video.label: App Store search results video (creative asset, iOS 27 and iPadOS 27)
appstore-search-video.notes: 3:2 from 1920x1280 to 3840x2560 (3840x2560 is this project's render size; any exact 3:2 with even sides in the range passes), 30 or 60 fps, 5 to 30 s, .mov, .m4v or .mp4. Loops continuously; muted in search results and cannot currently be unmuted, so an audio track is never heard. Set, a search results asset takes the place of in-app events, previews and screenshots in search on iOS 27 and iPadOS 27. Apple's guidance: the app's purpose obvious at a glance, the firsthand experience (interface, content, gameplay). Poster frame, pacing, loop and content rules as appstore-header-video. Apple lists no universal (16:9) video.

play-promo.label: Google Play promo video (uploaded to YouTube, linked in Play Console)
play-promo.notes: Play takes a YouTube URL, not a file: this skill makes the file, the user uploads it and pastes the URL. Only the first 30 s autoplays, so the point must land inside it. The video must be public or unlisted, embeddable, not age-restricted, with ads disabled; no playlist or channel URL and no extra parameters such as a timecode. Google recommends at least 80% of the video shows the actual app experience.

ph-video.label: Product Hunt launch video (uploaded to YouTube, linked in the post)
ph-video.notes: Product Hunt accepts only a full YouTube URL for video (a shortened link does not load). Gallery stills and the thumbnail are launch-graphics work.

ph-thumbnail-gif.label: Product Hunt animated thumbnail (GIF)
ph-thumbnail-gif.notes: Square, 240x240 recommended. Every image, GIF included, must be under 3 MB. A GIF animates only while the pointer is over the post, so the first frame has to stand on its own.

web-16x9.label: Web master, 16:9
web-16x9.notes: Not a platform rule: this project's default master, and the file to upload to YouTube for Play and Product Hunt.

social-9x16.label: Vertical cut, 9:16
social-9x16.notes: Not a platform rule. Safe zones and length limits for a specific social placement are not in this file: short-video owns those.

loop-1x1.label: Square feature loop
loop-1x1.notes: Not a platform rule: a silent loop for a changelog entry, a README or a feature card. Muted by default because autoplaying loops are muted.

loop-16x9.label: Wide feature loop
loop-16x9.notes: Not a platform rule: the loop that sits in a docs page or a release note.
